packet.title: Schema components and compile stages (design, build)

body.p: After . Owns new src/schema_internal.h, stub files src/schema_simple_type.c, src/schema_complex_type.c, src/schema_identity.c, src/schema_assertion.c, src/schema_validate.c. The component model of XSD 1.1 Part 1, 2.2, index-addressed in one arena per schema (, style): element and attribute declarations (scope, value constraint, nillable, abstract, substitution group heads, type table of alternatives, identity constraints, inheritable), attribute uses and groups, complex types (derivation method, final, block, abstract, content type: particle tree of model groups and particles, wildcards, open content, attribute uses and wildcard, assertions, defaultAttributesApply), simple types (the registered type identifier, facets with fixed, assertions), model group definitions, identity constraints (selector, fields, refer; xpathDefaultNamespace), notations; the name indexes of the schema per symbol space (types, elements, attributes, groups, attribute groups, identity constraints, notations) and substitution group members. Each XPath of a component is kept as text with its namespace context and base URI. The compile pipeline in stages, each a function of one file (read, resolve, simple types, complex types, identity constraints, assertions and alternatives) and the validator's seams (content model matcher, subtree recorder, ID table) declared; the stub files return SXML_STATUS_UNSUPPORTED_FEATURE (or do nothing) until their packets fill them, as 2.0's evaluator stubs did. Done when the components of three schemas (a purchase order, a recursive substitution group, an XSD 1.1 schema with assertions, alternatives and open content) are written out in comments, and the stubs build. Golden: src/xslt_ast_internal.h, src/evaluator_machine_internal.h. Done 2026-10-18 (): src/schema_internal.h (the component tables, references, lists, texts, namespace contexts and XPath records; the built-in components; struct sxml_schema; the compilation and its six stages; the content model matcher, the derivation check, the recorded subtree, the ID table and the assertion, alternative and identity seams; the three schemas in text form), src/schema_components.c (the store, the name index, blocks, built-in components, reports) with tests/schema_components_test.c, and the five stubs.
